artifact: GRENDEL BC4 independent full-statistics uncertainty campaign

combination.bottom_mass: extrema of central plus mb=4.5/5.0 GeV variations
combination.decay_model: interval between central and an independent central-FONLL simulation with LO-ChPT widths below 2 GeV and perturbative spectator widths above
combination.display: single_source_variation_envelope: outermost endpoint among the scale, PDF-percentile, bottom-mass, and decay-model intervals
combination.interpretation: one source varied at a time; no quadrature, no simultaneous-source coverage, and not a confidence band
combination.numerical_controls: two fresh-seed same-physics central repeats, reported separately and excluded from all physics intervals and the display envelope
combination.pdf: 16th and 84th percentiles (linear quantiles) of 100 NNPDF replica boundaries; sample standard deviation retained for audit
combination.rebase: component dex shifts applied to canonical published central curve
combination.scale: asymmetric envelope of central plus six coherent scale grids

independence_policy: Every variation has a fresh FONLL parent sample, scalar four-vectors, geometry, decay/reconstruction MC, and sensitivity scan. No event, weight, geometry, or detector-outcome reuse/reweighting across variations.
limitations: No FONLL alpha_s companion grids are included.
The decay alternate is a model envelope, not a Gaussian error.
The display envelope is not a confidence interval or simultaneous-source band.
Detector-response and background systematics are outside this theory envelope.

numerical_control_summary.definition: absolute boundary shifts of two fresh-seed, same-physics central repeats relative to the independent campaign central
numerical_control_summary.envelope_policy: excluded from every physics interval and display envelope
numerical_control_summary.subdominant_criterion: repeat maximum absolute dex shift is smaller than the largest one-source physical interval displacement at that mass/boundary

scratch_artifacts: external campaign workspace; published outputs are identified by content hashes rather than a machine-specific path

validation_against_triangle_backend.sample: 25000 scalar rays from the BC4 production pipeline
